video_title: Should You Use VS Code? 60-Second IDE Guide
voiceover_script: Looking for the perfect code editor? Today on IDE Guide, we're testing VS Code! The world's most popular lightweight, extensible code editor with massive extension ecosystem. Pricing model is Free (Open Source / MIT License). Top strengths include Massive marketplace, Lightweight & responsive. However, keep in mind Electron resource consumption with heavy plugins. Best suited for Web, Node.js, Python, and multi-language software engineers. Disclaimer: IDE Guide is an independent technical publication. This content is not sponsored, endorsed, or affiliated with any software vendor or editor developer mentioned above. All reviews and assessments are based strictly on objective developer evaluation.
